title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30125v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. translated_title: PhysiCalWorld：面向世界模型的上下文物理校准
translated_abstract: 现有的世界模型通常通过当前视觉帧或狭窄的历史窗口来感知场景。然而，这些观测可能无法揭示决定转移动态的物理属性，例如物体的质量分布、关节阻尼或表面摩擦力。如果不为世界模型校准这些物理因素，预测往往会退化为经验先验，并在新颖的测试场景中引发严重的漂移。为此，我们提出了PhysiCalWorld，它通过上下文提示（in-context prompting）将动作条件世界模型校准至特定实例的动力学，无需微调或解析式物理建模。我们的方法将在测试场景中收集的探索性交互片段编码为一个紧凑的物理描述符标记（physics descriptor token），从而使后续预测锚定于场景的实际物理行为。PhysiCalWorld仅依靠潜在预测损失进行端到端训练，无需任何物理标签。
tldr: PhysiCalWorld通过将测试场景中的探索性交互片段编码为紧凑的物理描述符标记，以上下文提示方式校准世界模型对实例特定动力学的感知，无需微调、解析物理建模或物理标签即可显著提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: PhysiCalWorld calibrates action-conditioned world models to instance-specific physics dynamics by encoding exploratory interaction clips into compact physics descriptor tokens via in-context prompting, requiring no fine-tuning, analytical physics modeling, or physics labels.
